typical_customer_profile: Our typical Vacay Keepsake customer is a US family—most often two parents traveling with young kids, teens, or grandparents—planning a 4- to 8-day domestic vacation to a major US tourist city, theme park, beach town, or national park at a mid-range or splurge spend. Usually mom or dad leads the planning on a phone or laptop in the evening, feels reasonably comfortable with everyday apps, and wants a quick chat-built daily plan plus a keepsake to remember the vacation. A smaller share are couples and friends groups, and a minority plan longer vacations to the UK, Canada, Ireland, Australia or New Zealand. Every test customer redeems a test coupon; no real payment.
